details: Bitcoin experienced a significant decline, falling below the $60,000 mark after the latest U.S. jobs report showed stronger-than-expected growth. This robust economic data has increased market expectations for the Federal Reserve to potentially raise interest rates, creating a bearish sentiment for risk assets like cryptocurrencies.
title: Bitcoin Dips Below $60K as Strong US Jobs Report Fuels Fed Rate Hike Bets

details: Zcash (ZEC) saw a dramatic price crash of up to 50% following the discovery of a critical vulnerability in its Orchard shielded pool. The flaw, which could have allowed for the creation of counterfeit ZEC, prompted an emergency patch and led to prominent crypto figure Arthur Hayes reportedly selling his entire Zcash holdings.
title: Critical Zcash (ZEC) Vulnerability Discovered, Leading to Price Crash

details: Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs) have continued to experience substantial outflows, marking a 13-day streak of net withdrawals that amounted to billions of dollars. However, BlackRock's IBIT ETF recently broke this trend with a notable $48 million inflow, offering a small counter-signal amidst the broader bearish sentiment for institutional Bitcoin products.
title: Bitcoin ETFs Face Record Outflows, Though BlackRock's IBIT Sees Inflow
